race.comment: Tricky race with a few who have shown a bit at the races up against some well-trialled debutants from some big stables. HYDROTHERMAL (8) is a maiden galloper who hasn't raced since finishing in the placings over 1543m at this track four months ago. Fitter for a recent trial win. Among the leading chances. ZENDARINA (2) wasn't far away on debut last start over 1200m at Moe, finishing second and beaten 4 lengths. Should improve sharply and this looks a nice race. ESCADEC (7) is a first starter from the Freedman camp who looked good at his latest trial, so a big showing is expected. EL CAMERO (6) has a tricky gate to contend with but has had three jumpouts this time in for two wins and a second, so is clearly going well.
